info.description:
- Workflow API Document: [https://wiki.paynamics.net/en/API_Paygate](https://wiki.paynamics.net/en/API_Paygate) notionvc: 4e53182a-dd6b-4473-b4b7-4c0ea5d19bb7
    
    - Sale/Purchase API Call Refer to Section: 10.1, 10.2 and 10.3
        
    - Query API Call Refer to Section: 10.8, 10.9 and 10.10
        
    - Refund API Call Refer to Section: 10.20, 10.21 and 10.22
        
    - Notes:  
        
        - Please send an email to "[appsupport@paynamics.net](https://mailto:appsupport@paynamics.net)" request to access “[https://wiki.paynamics.net/en/API_Paygate”](https://wiki.paynamics.net/en/API_Paygate%E2%80%9D).
            
        - Provide the email address you want to use to access Paynamics Wiki. Paynamcs will create you access to Paynamics Wiki.
            
            - Notes:  
                
                - Once this Postman Collection is exported on your Postman App. Find that Postman Collection on your Postman App. Click three circle icon beside the Postman Collection and Click Edit.
                    
                - A new screen will show. Select Tab “Authorization" then put your basic auth username and password on the authorization.
                    
                - Next Select Tab “Variables" put your test merchantid and mkey on merchantid and mkey variable field values.
                    
                - Now you're ready to test. Refer to api documents for the required fields for each api calls.
                    
- Workflow Process Flow: [RPF x Workflow HighLevel - WORKFLOW.pdf](https://paynamicstechnologies-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/leo_trinidad_paynamics_net/ET7O-rRKm9tSGn9ThwqHLFQBKoszkIKieuXjIwjpjJ4Oyg?e=IwHdOG) notionvc: 39cde1c7-470a-4e1f-8f84-a90fe3f59ea8

item.description:
Facebook messegenr integration allows you to create your own shopping cart page that you can render within facebook messenger itself.

**RECOMMENDED USER EXPERIENCE FLOW:**

1. Customer will visit your facebook message and initiate chat (or via facebook messenger)
    
2. Your messenger has a chatbot that will auto reply on your customer. This reply includes a ‘URL Button Template’ that has a button clickable for customer to display your shopping page via pop up web view.
    
3. Within your shopping page, customer will add items to cart, and then checkout.
    
4. Your shopping page will send a payment request to Paynamics, and we will repond with a redirect URL.
    
5. Your shopping page will redirect the customer to the redirect URL that we hav eprovided on step 4.
    
6. Customer will choose payment options and do the payment process.
    
7. Once done we will redirect your customer in your success or failed page, depending on the status of the payment.
    
8. Once done, you will send an automated reply to your customer via messenger that contains the transaction result.
    
9. Done. To view our demo use case, visit [https://m.me/104589504693144](https://m.me/104589504693144)

item.description:
Merchant may perform a cancellation of the Workflow API any time except for the following scenarios:

- If the Workflow API was set to single_pay and the payment has already been made successful.
    
- If the Workflow API was set to deferred_pay and all payment cycle is already tagged as  paid successful.
    
- If the Workflow API was set to dp_balance and both downpayment and balance is tagged as paid successful.
    

Please take note that the Work Flow Cancel Request will only nullify future payments (or payments that has not yet been tag as successful).  Merchant may perform a refund or reversal request should it require to nullify previous successful payments.
